# pidginhost_generations (Data Source)

Hardware generations servers and Kubernetes clusters can run on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_generations" "all" {}

output "default_generation" {
  value = one([for g in data.pidginhost_generations.all.generations : g.slug if g.is_default == true])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `generations` (Attributes List) Every hardware generation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--generations))

<a id="nestedatt--generations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `generations`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_label` (String) CPU model of the hosts.
- `dedicated_cpu` (Boolean) Whether vCPUs map 1:1 to host threads, without overcommit.
- `description` (String) Description of the hardware.
- `free_tier_eligible` (Boolean) Whether free tier packages are available on this generation.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the generation is used when none is selected.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `price_multiplier` (String) Multiplier applied to the base price, as a decimal string (1.00 = no change).
- `slug` (String) Short name of the generation, accepted wherever a generation is selected.
